data.name: Manasvi
data.gender_notes: Manasvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manasvi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘manas’ which means mind or intellect. This name is believed to represent one’s intellect and desire. In Hindu mythology, Manasvi is the name of a celestial nymph, or Apsara, who is known for her beauty and intelligence. The name Manasvi carries the meaning “Intellect, Mind, Desire” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manasvi usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, mind, desire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the mind in shaping one’s reality and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Manasvi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, Mind, Desire.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manasvi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
